alpha-persei-cluster.d: Young OB stellar association surrounding Mirfak in Perseus.

m4-globular.d: The closest globular cluster to the Solar System, situated in Scorpius near Antares.

carina-nebula.d: One of the largest diffuse emission nebulae in our sky, containing Eta Carinae and the Cosmic Cliffs.

leo-cloud.d: Unusually cold (~20 K), dense neutral hydrogen ribbon embedded within the hot Local Bubble cavity at ~7.5 parsecs.

vela-cloud.d: Fast-moving warm interstellar cloud in the southern Complex of Local Interstellar Clouds.
